pages.text: While the Risus can commonly be found in the form of living flesh, it also takes the form of burnt remains. Almost Coal-like, these Remains appear in three main forms: Smiling Remains - hard and covered with glowing smiles; Ashen Remains - silky smooth with an occasional eye pattern on it; and Spreading Remains - made of tangled ashen vines and covered in small blood postules.
These can be obtained by altering Netherrack, Soul Sand or Soil, and Glow Lichen respectively. They can also serve as fuel in furnaces.
